content: Tafaram Tanawasatan
Yait ebitumatum Jesu i Roubininenayan, nati orot i God natun. Naatu orot yait Tamat ebiyabuw natunatun auman boro niyabow.
Ef iti na’atube tasisinaf it boro tanaso’ob, it God taiyabuw ana ofafar tabobosiyasiyar, imih i natunatun tabiyabuwih.
Naatu ata yabow God tabitin, anayabin i ana ofafar tabobosiyasiyar imih i ana ofafar boro men isat hinafokaramih.
Naatu yait God natunamih baib i boro tafaram ana kakafin nawasatan. Imih Jesu tebitumitum anamaramaim tafaram ana kakafin tawasatan Satan umanane taikisisirit tatit.
Imih yait boro tafaram ana kakafin nawasatan? Orot yait ebitumatum Jesu i God Natun? I boro tafaram nigegesair Satan umanane nikisisir natit.
Jesu Keriso Ana Koubuna’ayah

Iti orot Jesu i taiyuwin na i’obaiyit i God Natun ana Roubininenayan. Imih Jesu bapataito baib ana maramaim, God i’obaiyit ta’itin. Naatu morob ana rara suwa re’er ana maramaim auman. Naatu Anun Kakafiyin sif rurubon i turobe. Anayabin Anun Kakafiyin i men baifufuwenayan.
Naatu iti sawar tounu i Jesu isan sif tirurubon.
Nati sawar i Anun Kakafiyin, harew, naatu rara, nah tounu hai tur i ta’imon sif hirubon.
Orot tafaram hai sawar isah sif erurubon i tabitumatum, baise God ana sif rurubon i fair kwanekwan, anayabin God sif rurubon i Natun Jesu Keriso isan sif rubon tanowar, Jesu i God Natun.

Imih orot yait God natun ebitumatum abisa God eo sif rurubon i dogoronamaim ema’am. Baise orot yait God eo men ebitumatum, nati orot iwa’an God baifuwenayan matar. Anayabin God Natun isan eo sif rurubon men ebitumatum.
God kukurereb i yawas wanatowan itit. Naatu iti yawas an i Natun wanawananamaim ema’am.
Imih orot yait God Natun nabaib yawas boro nab. Baise orot yait God Natun men nabaib yawas boro men nab.
Yawas Wanatowan
Ayu iti sawar kwa iyab God Natun kwabitumitum isa akikirum kwana’itin, saise kwanaso’ob, kwa i yawas wanatowan kwabai.
Imih God nanamaim boro koufair tanab, abisa isan i ana kokomaim tabifefeyan boro nanowar.
Mar etei isan tafefeyan i enonowar, nati i anababatun taso’ob, naatu abisa isan tabifefeyan ebitit auman taso’ob.

Taituwa bowabow kakafin sinaf kui’itin i boro men nan morob wan nayen, gewasin God isan kwanifefeyan yawas nitin maiye. Baise bowabow kakafin ta i boro nabonawiy morob wan kwanayen. Naatu ayu i men sabuw nati bowabow kakafin hisinaf hin morob wan hiyey isah yoyobanamih ao.
Ef kakafih tasisinaf etei i bowabow kakafih. Baise i wanawanahimaim bowabow kakafin ta boro men nanawiy inan morob wan inayenamih.
Taso’ob orot yait God natun boro men mar etei nama bowabow kakafin nasinafumih. Anayabin God Natun mar etei etatafafar, imih Demon Mowan boro men ni’afiyimih.
Tafaram tutufin etei i Demon ebi’aiwob. Baise taso’ob it i God nowan.

God Natun na, God anababatun isan bi’obaiyit i taso’ob. Naatu God anababatun wanawananamaim tama’am. Natun Jesu Keriso auman wanawananamaim iti God i turobe yawas wanatowan ma’ama’anin, imih ibasit bairit wanatowan tama’am.
Natunatu taiyuw kwanatafafari, god baifufuwenayah hinanan kwanahaiwih.
